main.summary: Disk-backed stream that supports incremental appends and blocking reads for live follow sessions.

field.name: path
field.summary: Full path to the backing file used to buffer followed bytes.

field.name: gate
field.summary: Serializes append operations and internal state transitions that mutate the backing stream.

field.name: signal
field.summary: Signals waiting readers when new bytes or a terminal state become available.

field.name: reader
field.summary: Lazily created read stream over the backing file.

field.name: readableLength
field.summary: Current readable byte length available to consumers.

field.name: terminalState
field.summary: Current terminal state controlling how readers and appenders behave.

field.name: faultMessage
field.summary: Optional fault message surfaced when the stream transitions to the faulted state.

field.name: disposed
field.summary: Tracks whether the stream has been disposed.

constructor.name: Constructor
constructor.summary: Initialize a buffered follow stream over a backing file.
constructor.param: Backing file path used to store followed bytes.
Initial readable length already available in the backing file.

method.name: AppendAsync
method.summary: Append newly downloaded bytes to the backing stream and unblock waiting readers.
method.param: Readable payload stream containing bytes to append.
Cancellation token for the append operation.

method.name: MarkCompleted
method.summary: Mark the buffered follow stream as completed and unblock any waiting readers.

method.name: MarkAborted
method.summary: Mark the buffered follow stream as aborted and unblock any waiting readers.

method.name: MarkFaulted
method.summary: Mark the buffered follow stream as faulted and unblock any waiting readers.
method.param: Optional fault message returned to readers.

method.name: GetTerminalState
method.summary: Get the current terminal state of the follow stream.

method.name: GetFaultMessage
method.summary: Get the current fault message associated with the follow stream.
method.returns: Current fault message, or null when none is set.

method.name: EnsureReader
method.summary: Get or create the lazily initialized reader over the backing file.
method.returns: Reader positioned over the backing file.

method.name: SetTerminalState
method.summary: Apply a terminal state and wake any waiting readers.
method.param: Optional fault message associated with the terminal state.

method.name: ThrowIfTerminalStateRejectsAppend
method.summary: Throw when append operations are no longer allowed because the stream reached a terminal state.

method.name: CreateSignal
method.summary: Create a new asynchronous signal used to wake blocked readers.

main.summary: Represents the terminal lifecycle state of a buffered follow stream.

field.name: Open
field.summary: The stream is open and may continue to receive appended bytes.

field.name: Completed
field.summary: The stream completed normally and readers should observe end-of-stream.

field.name: Aborted
field.summary: The stream was aborted and readers should observe an abort failure.

field.name: Faulted
field.summary: The stream faulted and readers should observe an error with the associated fault message when available.
